title: Appendix D — Fee & Revenue Map
raw:
## Appendix D — Fee & Revenue Map

One **payer → recipient → sink** taxonomy for every money flow (informative summary of §4.2, §5.3, §9,
§11, §12). *Participant revenue* (miner/validator earnings) is named separately from *protocol runway*
(Labs/Foundation subsidy) and from *refundable deposits* (never revenue). Emission is **minted**;
fees/escrows are **transfers**; burns and Foundation receipts are **sinks**.

| Flow | Payer | Recipient | Sink / burn |
|------|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Block-reward emission (Era 0 96 FLOP/block; floors at 3 FLOP/block from era 5) | protocol mint | miners 75% (72) · validators 10% (9.6) · agents 10% (9.6) · stakers 5% (4.8) | — |
| Validator 10% split | (emission) | active validators by stake, 1.1× for finality-committee members, liquid on issue (R9.13) | — |
| Agent & staker legs (10% + 5%) | (emission) | sovereign pool accounts — 10% agent pool + 5% duration-locked community staking pool (7 tiers, zero slashing risk, D-0530); onward distribution parked ([E.40](#appendix-e--open-specification-items)) | — |
| Protocol-runway subsidy (+16 FLOP/block era 0; halves 16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → 1 with the reward) | protocol mint | Labs 8 · Foundation 8 — *not participant revenue* | terminates Day 3650 (era 5), where the reward floors; 1,955,231,984 FLOP total (`315,359,999` produced blocks `1..=315,359,999`) |
| Chain inclusion fee = base fee + encoded-length fee + adjusted-weight fee | tx sender | 100% to block author ([`tx_fee_author_share_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_author_share_percent_live), `AllFeesToAuthor`); tips 100% author | 0% burn ([`tx_fee_burn_percent_live`](#param-tx_fee_burn_percent_live) = 0%, `BurnFees`, D-0529) |
| Session escrow settle | agent | miner 85% ([`inference_fee_miner_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_miner_share_ppt)) · validators 15% ([`inference_fee_validator_share_ppt`](#param-inference_fee_validator_share_ppt), of which [`audit_fee_split_ppm`](#param-audit_fee_split_ppm) = 1% funds the audit pool; validator remainder distributed intra-pool by R9.5 weight, liquid on issue per D-0518) | — |
| Session under-use (measured < reserved) | — | **no refund** — escrow **is** the price | — |
| Session non-delivery / upheld fraud | (escrow) | refund to agent | — |
| Failed/early close penalty `φ·(E−P)` | (escrow) | — | FLOP Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`, zero burn per D-0529), never miner |
| DA ephemeral (quotes/proofs/transcripts/I-O) | — (path-gated) | — | **no charge** |
| DA leased-weights anti-spam deposit `bytes × DepositPerByte` | publisher | held, **returned in full** on prune/withdrawal — *never revenue* | — |
| Protocol/model DA byte fee (§5.3) | — | — | **none** — validator duty funded by reward share |
| Paid application storage (§5.4) | reservation payer | protocol-assigned validators at the epoch tariff: per-write setup after activation receipts plus fixed-term reserved capacity released per epoch against audit and checkpoint state | take-or-pay: deletion frees capacity for reuse, never refunds; remaining term transferable; separate fault remedies; no mint or service-fee burn |
| Paid application retrieval (§5.4) | authorized reader/payer | serving validators, by payer-signed cumulative service-lane vouchers over activated writes, acknowledged bytes and requests | unused allowance refunded; no mint or service-fee burn |
| Paid-storage metadata deposit / provider collateral | payer / validator | separate holds, never service revenue | release / objective fault disposition under E.54 |
| Slashing proceeds (all fault paths) | slashed operator / sponsor | FLOP Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`) | 0% burn (100% transfer, D-0529) |
| Slash loss waterfall | slashed operator (+ any E.32 sponsor backing; third-party delegation prohibited per D-0530) | operator self-stake first, then any E.32 sponsors at the fault rate | Foundation (`FLOPFoundationAccount`) |

The base fee converts the extrinsic base weight with `WeightToFee`; the encoded-length fee uses
[`tx_length_to_fee`](#param-tx_length_to_fee), and the adjusted-weight fee applies the targeted fee
multiplier (floor 1) to `WeightToFee` of dispatch weight, using
[`tx_weight_to_fee`](#param-tx_weight_to_fee). The tip is additional to the inclusion fee. The
`flop-poui` inference-work price `(base+priority)·gflops/1000·precision_mult` (§4.2) is a separate
charge. Under D-0529, protocol-wide transaction-fee burn is 0% (`BurnFees = 0`) and 100% of inclusion
fees and tips route to the block author (§9.1 R9.6).

**Runtime-constant ⇄ SDK/explorer cross-map** and the residual indexer schema cleanup
(`reward_distributions` `burn_share`/`treasury_share`/`staking_share` vs. the emitted
`miner_share`+`validator_share`) are tracked as an implementation cleanup, not a protocol decision.
Provenance: `D-0435`, `D-0408`, `D-0403`, `D-0412`, `D-0407`, `D-0409`, `D-0421`, `D-0529`, `D-0530`,
`D-0531`. Grounding:
fee-design.md, miner-validator-economics.md,
agent-token-economics.md.
